args.message:
Fix FIN-212: use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money

The docstring specified ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212, but the
implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so
tests/test_money.py passes in the nightly build.

args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix FIN-212: implement banker's rounding in round_money
args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py` claimed to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212, but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`.
- This caused the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py` (e.g. `2.665` was expected to round to `2.66`, but rounded to `2.67`).
- Changed the implementation to use `Decimal.quantize(..., rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed.
